Yulia is a clumsy demon that works as a maid, but her true identity is the "Mist" a Nomad assassin.

In TABA she joined the Fuuma Organization early on, but in RPGX remains a sleeper agent in another city.


Personality
She mostly lives a double life between a lovely maid and ruthless killer.

Her facade is that of a slightly lewd but innocent housekeeper. At times dizzy, cutesy, clumsy and shy but always a loyal servant, which often speaks her own name in somewhat childish ways when addressing herself. She creates this persona using self-suggestion and will return to her normal personality in the case of a mission or if her life is in danger.

As the "Mist" mostly a cold professional. Loyal only to Nomad, willing to kill whoever she was asked too with no sign of hesitation. She is able to follow a target for a long time and remain fully hidden using her fake persona.

In TABA, she is sent out to kill Kotaro but as she is found out, and is unable to return to Nomad, wishes to kill him out of revenge. Her single-minded focus on him turns to love over time, but that does not stop her from wanting to kill him.

Appearance
She has dark skin and long white hair, red eyes.

Yulia is most often seen in her maid outfit.


History
Background
Yulia, known in the underworld as "The Mist" is an assassin of Nomad.

Only Edwin Black himself and other executives of Nomad know of her true identity.

She is sent out using disguises and infiltrates other rival organizations. Known in the Demon Realm as the Mist, people think she might be a man, but nobody knows her true identity as a young woman. Currently assigned as a migrated worker and maid. As Yulia, she infiltrated the Human Realm. This "sleeper agent persona" as a clumsy and rather simple but lovable maid, keeps her hidden, until Edwin Black needs her work and until then she provides him with intel.

Timeline TABA
Years before the beginning of Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena, year 2086 (or 2077), The Mist is sent after the Japanese leader of Task Force G, John Jarlson. Having killed him, he was replaced by a Doppelganger in his place, loyal to Nomad. Possibly to keep an eye on Fuuma Danjo, that became therefore active in "G" around that time.

Her story is mostly told in multiple (what if) TABA events past year 2082. Yulya is once more send out, this time after the Fuuma Organization. She claims to be a demon maid on the run from Edwin Black and Nomad, asking Fuuma Kotaro for protection. Working as a maid for him, she has many sexual encounters with him. Kotaro grows to like her but one night she disappears, secretly meeting up with Ingrid giving Nomad information about the hideout. Caught in the act by Kotaro, Ingrid escapes, but Yulia is captured. The hideout is later attacked by Nomad, using the information, but in the end the Fuuma Organization is able to fend them off. Now a captured, a slave seal is placed on Yulia, and she becomes part of a Chaos Arena punishment. Able to escape later, she becomes a bounty hunter, as Nomad and Fuuma Organization dropped her, now killing mostly demons. She is shaken a lot by her mixed feelings of revenge, lust and love for Fuuma, not sure what to do.

Timeline RPGX
She is currently undercover in the downtown area of Maesaki City under the orders of Black, disguising her identity as a migrant worker from the demon world. Yulia usually works as a temporary housekeeper, gathering information and carrying out assassinations according to Black's orders. In order to prevent people from knowing her true identity, she usually suggests herself to appear as a different person in advance.

Only when Black's orders arrive, or when she is in danger, does she revert to his ruthless assassin persona.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Daggers

Trained Assassin: Mist Killer, able to kill without trace and sound.
Trained Maid
Good Actor
